selection.product: System Three T-88 Structural Epoxy Adhesive
selection.selection_authority: The prior owner instruction authorized the assistant to select a reasonable adhesive. This is that conditional assistant selection; the owner has not named, purchased, or delivered the product.
selection.history_reconciliation: The earlier material-support reuse assessment predates this selection and recorded T-88 as not selected. The separate, later T-88 selection record reflects the owner's authorization for an assistant selection; it does not claim the owner chose a specific product.

retailer_sourcing.saved_finding: The bounded Home Depot search did not surface T-88; the Lowe's System Three epoxy category screen listed SculpWood, RotFix, and EndRot but not T-88.
retailer_sourcing.practical_gap: No Home Depot/Lowe's SKU or local stock source is bound for the retained T-88 selection. The manufacturer product page remains the product source; no substitute is selected here.

current_target.owner_specified_conditional_category: APA 24oc PS1, Group 1, at least five plies; actual grade stamp, layup, thickness, face condition, moisture, and orientation remain unobserved.
current_target.joint: Face-to-face bond between the two leaves of each plywood cleat. Bolts remain a separate mechanical load path.
current_target.stiffness_operator: Two published single-panel operators combined as one perfectly bonded body. Perfect interleaf compatibility/no slip is a model assumption, not a measured or validated property.
current_target.not_carried_forward: No half-inch/Candidate 13 or other historical plywood stiffness, capacity, or force result is transferred.

manufacturer_process_reference.product_class: Manufacturer describes T-88 as a structural epoxy for woodworking and marine applications and places structural adhesives among products that may be considered for load-bearing construction and repair. This supports the conditional product-class selection, not this joint's capacity or stiffness.

mix.instruction: Use one measurement basis accurately; do not interpret the volume ratio as the weight ratio.

application_conditions.surface_guidance: Manufacturer guidance calls for clean, sanded surfaces (no finer than 150 grit) and solvent wiping. The saved TDS gives a Douglas-fir wood preparation instruction; actual plywood face veneer thickness, finish/overlay, moisture, and sanding allowance are unobserved. Do not sand through veneer or bond through an unverified coating.
application_conditions.joint_fit_and_contact: T-88 is described for normally fitted joints. The TDS says clamping is unnecessary if the joint is undisturbed during setup; keep mating faces in contact and avoid squeeze-out/starved bondlines. No numerical clamp pressure is specified for this laminate.
application_conditions.spread_guidance_limit: TDS lists 5–8 mil coverage data; the general manufacturer usage bulletin estimates 3–4 mil glue lines for clamped joints. These are generic product/usage data, not a target spread, gap tolerance, or qualified full-face process for this plywood cleat.

cure.low_temperature_note: The prior T-88 selection record notes approximately one week cure near 35°F; colder/slower cure conditions must follow the current product instructions.
cure.interpretation: Do not treat the prior record's 24-hour functional-strength statement as full cure. Product cure timing is not design qualification of the actual bond.

manufacturer_process_reference.water_resistance: Manufacturer describes T-88 as waterproof; separate outdoor wood moisture cycling can stress adhesive/wood bonds as wood swells and dries.

published_product_data_and_limits.source: Cached manufacturer T-88 TDS, bound below.
not_published_for_target: Design allowable or resistance factor for two APA plywood faces.
Cured bondline shear modulus G, bondline thickness t, or force-slip stiffness G/t for this target.
Creep/slip or relaxation data applicable to this cleat.
Plywood-to-plywood laminate test matching the current species/grade/layup, face prep, bondline, cure, moisture, and load direction.
published_product_data_and_limits.coupon_data_use: TDS values are not converted into cleat capacities or stiffness. No strength ratio against the current nominal demand is reported.

current_beam_demand_reference.meaning_and_limit: A nominal mean stress if this represented beam-resultant flow were uniformly spread over the assumed full 139.7 mm width. The physical cleat is trapezoidal; the beam operator is a full-width approximation. This is not a physical bond traction bound, peel result, or adhesive capacity check.

operator_identity.derivation: q = Vu·EA_leaf·a/EI_pair, using the paired operator EI=2·EI_leaf,published+2·EA_leaf·a². The published leaf EI terms are retained; a homogeneous bt³/12 replacement is not used.

shear_lag_parameterization.idealized_relation: For two identical axial leaves coupled by continuous linear interface shear stiffness k' per unit length, lambda = sqrt(EA_leaf/(2*k')); if k'=(G_a/t_a)*b then G_a/t_a = EA_leaf/(2*b*lambda^2). This is a simple long-wavelength shear-lag parameterization only, not a calibrated plywood/cleat model.
unreported_inputs: An owner- or method-supported allowable slip or transfer length
shear_lag_parameterization.why_no_number: T-88 viscosity and coupon strength do not determine cured G/t. No permissible slip or transfer-length threshold is specified by the owner or supported by the saved analysis, so the formula cannot be turned into a pass/fail threshold without inventing one.

unresolved_joint_effects: Local peel or normal tension at the glue interface.
Discrete bolt-hole load introduction between leaves.
Torsional/warping transfer and finite-width stress variation.
Creep, cyclic/reversed loading, fatigue, and moisture-driven bond stress.
Actual plywood grade/layup/face, adhesive, surface prep, spread, bondline, cure, and physical bond quality.

Loctite_PL_Premium.status: Retail-listed comparison only; not selected for current cleats.
Loctite_PL_Premium.reason: Its ASTM D3498/APA AFG-01 results concern plywood/OSB bonded to floor-system framing (Douglas-fir lumber-to-plywood), not plywood-to-plywood cleat lamination. No target G/t or laminate stiffness basis is supplied. Its listed availability therefore does not resolve the T-88 sourcing gap or validate perfect composite action.

alternative_product_scope.Titebond_III: Not considered as a structural option; manufacturer product page says it is not for structural/load-bearing applications.

manufacturer_usage_bulletin.scope: Generic glue-line usage estimate; 3–4 mil clamped joints for the listed adhesive family/wood categories, not a target V11 plywood-cleat specification.

ASTM_D3498_scope.locators: Scope 1.1–1.2: field-gluing structural panels to wood-based floor-system framing; not an application specification.

Titebond_III_manufacturer_limit.locator: Limitations: not for structural or load-bearing applications.
